revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 3.9%, FY2024 0.1%; modest recovery to mid-single-digit life-science/diagnostics market growth, fading in the final year

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 GAAP EBIT margin 17.4% (7746/44556), FY2024 17.1%; slight improvement from productivity and falling amortization

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate 17% effective rate; analyst estimate, not taken from a filing (verify in the 10-K tax note)

da_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 D&A 2780/44556 = 6.2% (depreciation + intangible amortization), held flat

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM cost of equity = Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + beta ~0.95 (assumed, not looked up) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~9.1%; pre-tax cost of debt ~5.3% (assumed, interest 1419 / debt 39385 is about 3.6%) after tax ~4.4%; assumed 85/15 equity/debt weights (no share price available) gives ~8.3%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal US GDP growth

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt: total debt 39385 (ltd_noncurrent 35852 + debt_current 3533) - cash 9852 - short-term investments 253; acc. 0000097745-26-000018
